## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user. Include a short
before/after example when helpful.

## Issue

<!-- Link the issue using Closes #N, or Refs #N for a partial implementation. -->

## Validation

Record actual commands and results, relevant CI status, and manual or real-photo
checks. Explain any checks that could not run and any material limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is focused and matches the linked issue's scope.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria and regression cases have been checked.
- [ ] `ruff check fotosort tests` and `pytest` pass; relevant CI checks pass.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and affected documentation are updated.
- [ ] Photo/sidecar handling and report compatibility are checked where affected.

For selection changes, include the baseline, dataset, measured results, and
limitations. Synthetic tests alone do not establish photographic accuracy.
